title: ELDRATH
author: FewEntertainment9716
selftext:
I've created a short concept trailer for my game, which is currently being developed using Opus and Sol.

The game is called Eldrath, a first-person open-world RPG featuring some pretty challenging boss fights.

I'm still a very long way from release, but I wanted to put together a concept trailer to introduce the game and share it with you all.

The world will be quite vast, featuring dungeons, different biomes, a storyline, cutscenes, and much more.

The trailer mainly showcases dragon bosses, but there will be many, many other bosses to encounter throughout the game.

I'm really happy with how things are coming along so far, although I know there's still a huge amount of work to be done, with plenty of things to improve and features to implement.

It's going to be a long journey, but I'm really enjoying the process!
